text: Marcus Oyelaran packages Haverbrook Tickets' two services into containers: catalog-api on Node.js, and checkout-api on Python and FastAPI.
Each Dockerfile uses a multi-stage build -- one stage to compile, a slim final stage to run -- as a dedicated non-root user.
Both services expose a separate /healthz endpoint for container health checks, apart from their actual business logic.
checkout-api's existing checkout flow already calls VoltPay to charge the customer and handles declines or timeouts entirely within its own code.
Next: wiring both images into a real GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.
